dump_km_label_cli: run the CLI script to dump k-means cluster labels for HUBERT features from a feature directory
ApplyKmeans_class: create an ApplyKmeans object that loads a k-means model and assigns cluster labels to feature vectors
ApplyKmeans_call: call an ApplyKmeans instance on a numpy array or torch tensor to get cluster assignments
get_feat_iterator: get a feature iterator that yields audio feature chunks from sharded numpy files with length offsets
dump_label_function: dump k-means cluster labels for all features in a split shard to a text file in the label directory
